howItWorks.title: How AI Pre-Screening Works
howItWorks.description: Our AI-powered process reviews your medical information and reports to guide you toward the right treatment, hospital, and specialist in India — saving time, money, and uncertainty.

step1.title: Share Your Medical Details
step1.desc: Fill a simple, secure form with basic patient information, medical condition & symptoms, country of residence, and preferred treatment destination.

step2.title: Upload Medical Reports
step2.desc: Upload any available documents such as prescriptions, blood reports, MRI/CT/PET scans, biopsy reports, or discharge summaries.

step3.title: AI Medical Analysis
step3.desc: Our advanced AI engine reads and structures your medical data, identifies key clinical indicators, and matches your case with treatment pathways.
step3.time: AI trained on global clinical data

step4.title: AI Pre-Screening Report
step4.desc: Receive a clear, easy-to-understand AI Pre-Screening Report within 2 hours including preliminary insights, treatment options, and next steps.

reportIncludes.title: What the AI Pre-Screening Report Includes
reportIncludes.important: Important: Final treatment decisions are always confirmed by doctors. AI Pre-Screening provides preliminary guidance only.

conversionBooster: 95% of patients say AI Pre-Screening helped them make a confident treatment decision.

afterScreening.title: What Happens After AI Pre-Screening?
afterScreening.subtitle: Once you receive your report, you can choose to:
items: Speak with a medical expert / care coordinator
Get a doctor's opinion from top Indian hospitals
Proceed with visa, travel, accommodation & care coordination

disclaimer.title: Important Disclaimer
disclaimer.text: AI Pre-Screening provides preliminary medical guidance and does not replace a doctor's diagnosis. Final treatment decisions are made only after evaluation by qualified medical professionals.
